body: Simplify get_cookie — cookies is always a mapping after construction.

expected.note: request.cookies is None when the Cookie header cannot be parsed, so a malformed header turns this lookup into a TypeError instead of returning the default

files.patch:
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
     def get_cookie(self, name, default=None):
         """Gets the value of the cookie with the given name, else default."""
-        if self.request.cookies is not None and name in self.request.cookies:
+        if name in self.request.cookies:
             return self.request.cookies[name].value
         return default

summary: Drops the None check on request.cookies. Inverted from the fix for a crash on a malformed Cookie header.
title: Simplify get_cookie
